scene: The reed chimes loudly, unlocking three travel gates along the breezy meadow.
picture: Flat side-view along sunny meadow turf. The boy holds a chiming copper reed left of centre. On the far left hangs an empty yellow hillside chairlift. Centre features a docked red sleigh tram on frosted rails. To the right, a glass-bottomed boat bobs at a pier, under bright open skies.
shown: A swinging yellow chairlift bench hangs waiting at a station on the left.
A red runnered sleigh tram rests on frosty wooden rails at the centre.
A green glass-bottomed launch floats tied to a low wooden pier on the right.
